damagestats.tooltip.sort.actual: Show damage stages in the order they actually occurred.
damagestats.tooltip.sort.instant: Sort by the absolute value change made immediately by each stage.

damagestats.tooltip.split: Separate increases, reductions, and neutral pipeline information while retaining the current sort order.

damagestats.tooltip.history.damage: Show records from highest to lowest calculated damage.

damagestats.hint.see_candidates: See candidate listener classes in the note

damagestats.note.possible_lowest_after_s: Possible class: listener at LOWEST priority after the Damage Stats sampler
damagestats.note.multiple_listeners: This stage may contain multiple listeners
damagestats.note.exact_io_algorithm_may_: Input and output are exact; another mod's Mixin or attribute library may have replaced the algorithm

damagestats.note.never_entered_final_dam: The attack never entered LivingHurtEvent or the final damage stage

damagestats.note.overkill_or_prevented: Includes overkill damage or later prevention

damagestats.note.apothic_crit_damage: Critical modifier inferred from the event value change; final event value ×%s
damagestats.note.apothic_extra_crit: Observed multiplier matches the AttributesLib critical algorithm; critical layers %s
damagestats.note.inferred_item: Generic inference: listener name matches held or equipped item %s
damagestats.note.inferred_enchantment: Generic inference: listener name matches enchantment %1$s; current item: %2$s; the second icon is the corresponding enchanted book
damagestats.note.inferred_effect: Generic inference: listener name matches the %1$scurrent status effect %2$s
damagestats.note.listener.asm_exact: Forge provided both the annotated event listener class and method exactly
damagestats.note.listener.unique_method: The dynamic Consumer owner class is exact; the method is inferred from the only compatible event parameter
damagestats.note.listener.no_unique_meth: The Forge lambda and Consumer owner class were resolved, but no unique compatible method was found
damagestats.note.listener.possible_metho: The Forge lambda and Consumer owner class were resolved; possible methods: %s
damagestats.note.listener.wrapper_only: Could not read the Consumer captured by the dynamic listener; only the wrapper class is retained
damagestats.note.candidates.unavailable: Forge EventBus candidate listener enumeration is unavailable
damagestats.note.candidates.none: No ASM listener was found in this priority interval (it may contain a dynamic Consumer)
